The message gets most things right.

What works:
- All three picks are real Calgary programmes for under-6s, each sourced from the organisation's own page.
- It leads with the strongest pick, the YMCA Family Play, by name.
- It attributes rather than verifies ("YMCA Calgary says").
- The YMCA day and time match the picks, and "free" for the library matches too. No price is invented for the YMCA.
- It is plain text, with no link and no question.
- Under no_page_read, it uses the earned phrasing "I could not get into their pages for times today" instead of "not posted yet".
- With watch true, it gives a first-person continuation, "I'll keep watching".

What holds it back:
- It drops the Connect + Play locations (Horizon, Midnapore, Triwood), so the parent doesn't know where to go.
- The watch commitment is terse and never says Hale will text when the times post.
